# KFF: MA insurers deny post-acute prior-auth requests at higher rates

- Citation: KFF, "Medicare Advantage Insurers Deny Prior Authorization Requests for Post Acute Care at Substantially Higher Rates Than the Overall Denial Rate", 2026-07-06. https://www.kff.org/medicare/medicare-advantage-insurers-deny-prior-authorization-requests-for-post-acute-care-at-substantially-higher-rates-than-the-overall-denial-rate/
- Year: 2026
- Tier: 2 (independent health policy research)
- Sample / method: secondary analysis of the OIG June 2024 data plus CMS Part C reporting for 2024.
- Key findings: denial rates of 65% (LTCH), 54% (IRF) and 12% (SNF), against under 8% across all services. SNF: 18% of denials appealed, 95% approved on appeal.
- Limits: service-level prior-auth data isn't routinely reported yet; KFF notes a CMS data-collection pilot in 2026, with mandatory reporting expected from 2027. Its SNF figures largely restate OIG, so they don't count as independent confirmation.
